name: Short Put Ladder (Bull Put Ladder)
summary: Sell 1 higher put, buy 1 middle put, buy 1 lower put; a credit structure with defined upside, a loss valley in the middle, and a very large payoff on a crash.

legs.strike_rule: K3 = ITM or ATM, put delta -0.55 to -0.70
K2 = K3 - W, put delta -0.35 to -0.45; W = 1.5-2.5% of spot
K1 = K2 - W (equal spacing), put delta -0.20 to -0.30

when_to_use: IV rank < 30 with reasonably flat put skew - hard to find on equity indexes, easier on single names after a squeeze. It is a put ratio backspread with the second long pushed further out, trading upside slope for a shallower valley.
max_profit: very large on a move toward zero (bounded by K1 x 100 plus the structure)
max_loss: (K3 - K2) x 100 - net credit, reached at K2. Defined.
breakevens: upper: none when opened for a credit; lower breakeven = K1 - (K3 - K2) + credit/100 (solve exactly)

greeks.delta: near flat at entry, strongly negative below K1

entry_rules: Open for a net CREDIT; reject debit fills.
Skew filter: (IV at K1) - (IV at K3) <= 4.0 vol points, otherwise no credit is achievable.
Equal strike spacing; K3 delta -0.55 to -0.70, K2 -0.35 to -0.45, K1 -0.20 to -0.30.
Max loss ((K3 - K2) x 100 - credit) <= 1.5% of equity per unit.
All three strikes: OI >= 500, per-leg spread <= max($0.05, 10% of mid).
Single 3-leg limit order at mid; must remain a credit.
management_rules: Close at 100% of the max-loss amount in profit.
Close at 14 DTE regardless of P/L.
Stop at 60% of theoretical max loss.
exit_rules: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: 1 short put at K3, deliberately placed ITM or ATM - assignable from day one. Flatten by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if the K3 short put is ITM with extrinsic < $0.10.
assignment_risk: One short put at K3, chosen ITM/ATM, so early assignment risk exists from entry. Assignment buys 100 shares at K3 - a $10k-$60k cash event - hedged economically by the two long puts but operationally unacceptable. Deep ITM short puts lose extrinsic quickly and are assigned for carry reasons.
buying_power: (K3 - K2) x 100 - net credit, per unit.
common_mistakes: Attempting it on SPY/QQQ where put skew makes a credit impossible; opening for a debit; holding through the valley at K2 into expiry; ignoring that the ITM short put is assignable at any time.
zero_dte_notes: Not recommended - an ITM short put at 0DTE means same-day share delivery, and the crash payoff needs more than a day.
family: three-leg-structures (butterflies, broken-wing butterflies, lizards, three-strike ratio spreads, ladders/tree spreads, christmas trees, and three-leg stock+option hybrids)
bias_note: bearish breakout with a neutral consolation prize; long-vol
